Video shared by Karan Johar sparks excitement, but here's the truth! 
 TOI Entertainment Desk / etimes.in / Nov 17, 2026, 14:48 IST Save Comments Share Aa + Text Size Small
 Medium
 Large
 Print Karan Johar has sparked fresh excitement among fans of 'Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham' with a new video hinting at something special around the film. The filmmaker's Instagram post features Kareena Kapoor Khan and Hrithik Roshan stepping back into their popular characters, Poo and Rohan. However, the inclusion of Airbnb in the post has also led to speculation that the announcement could be part of a brand collaboration rather than a new project. Posted on Tuesday, the promo revisits the world of the 2001 family drama, bringing back some of its most recognisable moments. Kareena and Hrithik recreate familiar scenes, including Poo's detailed make-up routine, her signature red sandals and Rohan's black leather jacket, instantly reminding viewers of their characters. Watch Kareena Kapoor Sparks Debate Over Airport Queue And IPL Stadium Moments As Videos Go Viral Online The video concludes with the date 19.11.26, indicating that more details could be revealed on November 19. Karan has not yet explained what the date signifies, leaving fans guessing whether it marks a new announcement, a promotional reveal or something connected to the film's universe. "Kuch kahaaniyan 25 saal baad bhi khatam nahi hoti (sic)," Karan wrote in the caption, further fuelling curiosity about what he has planned. However, fans shouldn't get excited and expected a film. This looks more like a brand collaboration with a logo at the end of the video, which has added another dimension to the speculation. While the nostalgic promo has prompted fans to wonder if Poo and Rohan could be returning for a new project, the brand's involvement suggests that the video may also be linked to a marketing campaign. Whether it is a collaboration, a project announcement or a mix of both remains unclear. Join conversation

 There is currently no official confirmation of a sequel to 'Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham' or a separate OTT series based on its characters. Talks of a show exploring the film's universe have surfaced previously, and this latest teaser has once again brought the possibility into focus. And even if this is a brand collaboration, this will mark the on-screen pair's reunion after around 23 years. They last starred together in 'Main Prem Ki Deewani Hoon' in 2003. As the 2001 film 'K3G' approaches its 25th anniversary, seeing Kareena and Hrithik reprise Poo and Rohan has been enough to send fans down memory lane. Poll Vote & Share your view
